capabilities: Resize the currently edited Canvas text node while typing
Measure rendered Markdown to tighten width and height after editing
Add extra width padding for CJK text and anti-wrap while editing
Configure expansion direction, maximum width, and line-height fallbacks
Show auto-size debug output from the command palette
disambiguation: Not an automatic Canvas layout tool; it resizes only the node being edited and never moves neighboring nodes.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.12.0 or newer; additional Chinese-language documentation is available in the repository.
problem: Obsidian Canvas text nodes keep a fixed size, so typing forces manual resizing or causes text to wrap awkwardly.
summary: Canvas helper that automatically resizes the text node you are currently editing so its width and height fit the content as you type.
